(j, k) = argmin u,v∈[0,g],u≤v (h(s (i) 0 , s u ) -h(s u , s v ) + h(s v , s (i) g )) s.t. |v -u| = x × n y (i) ← {(s (i) 0 , s j ), "Sys1"} y (i) ← y (i) + {(s j , s k ), "Sys2"} y (i) ← y (i) + {(s k , s (i) g ), "Sys1"} D c ← D c + {(s (i) 0 , s (i) g ), y (i) } return D c A.1 BACKGROUND ON A *
